projects.title: USU Aerospace Wingcraft Web Application
projects.description: An interactive 3D airplane-wing modeling application for USU Aerospace. Users can adjust wing parameters and preview animated flight paths; Blender models and backend data sharing support the experience.

projects.title: Drug Screening Analysis Program
projects.description: A Python analysis tool for multiplex high-throughput drug-screening data from flow cytometry. The resume reports saving 200+ hours of manual work and about $1,500 in labor costs; the project is associated with a peer-reviewed study.

projects.title: 3D Character Configurator
projects.description: An interactive 3D character configurator built with React Three Fiber. Users can adjust character attributes, swap components, and preview changes in real time.

projects.title: 3D Molecule Maker
projects.description: A browser-based 3D molecule maker and viewer built with React Three Fiber and GLTF models for interactive molecular visualization.
